leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a runtime validator function using TypeScript's type predicates
Construct a type inference bridge that connects runtime validation to compile-time types
Apply validation logic to enforce data constraints at runtime
Configure type-safe error handling for validation failures
Integrate the validator and type bridge into a simple data processing pipeline
Manipulate TypeScript's type system to reflect validation results in the code editor
Initialize a validation schema and generate corresponding TypeScript types
lessonTitle: Build runtime validator and inferred type bridge
